title: rollout_task_submit
description: Submit an async RL rollout task. Non-blocking; may prewarm KV-cache prefix for the workspace. Polar-compatible Phase 9 API (Feature E/G).

description.description: Natural-language task description for the agent harness.

workspace_id.description: Shadow workspace UUID; used to resolve base tree OID for prefix caching.

max_steps.description: Maximum agent steps before rollout termination.

trainer_callback_url.description: Optional URL for session_result callbacks when trajectories are ready.

prewarm_kv_prefix.description: When true and KV router enabled, prewarm shared prefix before agent starts.

prefix_key.description: BLAKE3 prefix key when prewarm requested.
